## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `absence-as-signal-coverage-complement`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-29T04:53:05.081Z.

Entry slug absence-as-signal-coverage-complement. Purpose: report what the served context does not cover, over a declared partition, so the agent learns the shape of its own blind spot in the same call. Today a context or search answer is a ranked list and its silence is indistinguishable from absence of subject matter. Mechanism. Declare a coverage partition - the natural ones already exist in this product: the files graph, the docs graph, the type and epic partition, and the area tags. For a request, compute the intersection of the task's declared scope with the partition, subtract the union of the partition cells covered by the served set, and report the residual cells ranked by intersection weight times unclaimedness, where unclaimedness is how few active items reference the cell at all. Emit at most k residual cells with their weight, never their contents, so the cost is bounded by k rather than by corpus size. The output answers the question that the mandate to track everything actually poses: you are editing this file and no open item owns it; this epic has eleven children and none of them is reachable from the work you are doing. Distinction from neighbours. Learning-progress-guided gap scheduling ranks what the workspace should learn next as an exploration queue over epistemic value; this reports, per request, which declared cells the current answer failed to touch, and it is silent when coverage is complete. Retrieval-without-outcome measures served items that led nowhere; this measures cells that were never served at all. Inhibition-of-return suppresses what has already been shown; this surfaces what has never been shown. Degenerate case: when the served set covers every intersecting cell the residual is empty and the receipt is one empty field, so a small workspace where every file is owned by an item pays a constant. When no partition is declared, the entry is inert.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
